title: Crystal Clear Bar Salts Strawberry Kiwi Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Crystal Clear Strawberry Kiwi Nic Salt combines lush Strawberry with tart Kiwi for a simple, fruity vape. The sweetness of the Strawberry is balanced by the sharp bite of Kiwi, creating a bright and juicy profile that's easy to enjoy. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this Nic Salt e-liquid is ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with pod kits and vape pens. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths for a smooth throat hit and quick nicotine delivery. Crystal Clear Nic Salts are crafted to deliver the same great-tasting flavours that made disposable vapes so popular, now reimagined for refillable pod kits. Designed for clarity, consistency and convenience, this UK-made range focuses on fruity, icy, and confectionery-inspired blends that cater to everyday vapers.
